get.description: The text extracted from the resource's content with where each run of it is on a page, as the Smelter stored it under the content's checksum: what the gateway serves at its own `GET /resources/{id}/anchored-text`. The answer is always one of the members of `AnchoredTextAnswer`, and `kind` says which: the text, a stored decline, or why there is none. A resource whose media type has no derived text is answered `no-map` at once, and the store is not read. With no entry stored for one that has, the Archivist waits for the Smelter to say it has settled that content (`smelt:settled`) before it answers; docs/protocol/ARCHIVIST.md says how long. A resource the record does not hold, and one whose content has no checksum, is answered `unknown`. It never runs an extractor.

200.description: The anchored text, a stored decline, or why there is none.

put.description: Store what the Smelter derived from the bytes of this resource, under their checksum: every resource whose bytes those are has it then. The entry is written whole, beside its name and moved onto it, and replaces one stored under the same checksum. The resource's first representation must have these bytes: content that changed while it was read is derived again from what it is now. Called by the Smelter only; no client writes anchored text.

404.description: The record holds no such resource.

409.description: The resource's first representation has other bytes than the checksum the write states, or none; `error` names the checksum it has.
